scope: Native single-placement WASM text/code conflict synchronization

checks: Publish a two-block UTF8/CRLF conflict and its exact Weave receipt
Clone to an independent native Store with verified fragment closure
Select one block, publish, reopen, receive identical partial state
Select final block, publish, receive exact original bytes
Reject seven forged receipt profiles/executions with recomputed identities

Interrupt and resume a 16 MiB file; final digest exact
Two and ten concurrent native publishers retain every divergence
